title: Dataset Protection via Watermarked Canaries in Retrieval-Augmented LLMs
abstract: arXiv:2502.10673v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has become an effective method for enhancing large language models (LLMs) with up-to-date knowledge. However, it may pose a risk of copyright infringement, as IP datasets may be incorporated into the knowledge database by malicious Retrieval-Augmented LLMs (RA-LLMs) without authorization. To protect the rights of the dataset owner, an effective dataset membership inference algorithm for RA-LLMs is needed. In this work, we introduce a novel approach, \textit{CanaryTrace}, to safeguard the ownership of text datasets and effectively detect unauthorized use by RA-LLMs. Our approach preserves the original data completely unchanged while protecting it by inserting specifically designed canary documents into the IP dataset. translated_title: 通过带水印的金丝雀文档保护检索增强大语言模型中的数据集
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成（RAG）已成为利用最新知识增强大型语言模型（LLMs）的有效方法。然而，它可能带来版权侵权的风险，因为知识产权数据集可能被恶意的检索增强大语言模型（RA-LLMs）未经授权地纳入其知识数据库中。为了保护数据集所有者的权利，需要一种针对RA-LLMs的有效数据集成员推断算法。在这项工作中，我们提出了一种新颖的方法——CanaryTrace，用于保护文本数据集的所有权，并有效检测RA-LLMs的未授权使用。我们的方法在保持原始数据完全不变的同时，通过在知识产权数据集中插入专门设计的金丝雀文档来实现数据保护。这些金丝雀文档由合成内容构成并嵌入了水印，以确保其唯一性、一致性和统计可证明性。在检测过程中……
tldr: 提出CanaryTrace方法，通过在知识产权数据集中插入带有水印的金丝雀文档，在不修改原始数据的前提下，有效检测检索增强大语言模型（RA-LLMs）对数据集的未授权使用，从而保护数据集所有者的版权。
en_tdlr: Proposes CanaryTrace, a novel approach that safeguards dataset ownership by inserting specially designed watermarked canary documents into IP datasets without altering the original data, enabling effective detection of unauthorized dataset use by retrieval-augmented LLMs.
